title: sundgren.graph/2
description: A map of branches around the tip of a base branch, from `sundgren graph`. The base is the reference line; the other lanes are the target and the branches most contained in it, among those visible in the frame. The drawing is a grid of cells, one character each: `sundgren graph --format text` prints the same grid as Unicode.

target.description: The branch the others are ranked against; null when none was given.

threshold.description: Fuzzy threshold of the containment ranking (above 1: exact only).

candidates.description: How many branches were visible in the frame, before keeping the top N.

commits.description: Commits drawn in the frame, oldest first. A commit on twin lanes is listed once.

frame.description: Which stretch of time is drawn. `offset` counts first-parent commits of the base back from its tip to the newest base commit in the frame.

older.description: The offset one step back in time (overlapping this frame), or null at the start of history.

newer.description: The offset one step forward (overlapping), or null at the tip.

columns.description: The most commit columns asked for (`--columns`).

branch.description: The branch both twins belong to: `feat-b` for `feat-b` and `origin/feat-b`.

family.description: Colour family, by order of appearance; twins share it. null for protected lanes (their own colour).

twin.description: Index of the other lane of the same branch, if drawn.

pinned.description: Shown regardless of rank: the base, the target, `--pin`.

merged.description: The tip is in the base's history (nothing ahead): drawn faded.

only.description: The branch has no twin at all: `remote` is drawn dashed.

behind.description: Base commits not in the lane.

score.description: How much of the branch's work is found in the target's (0 to 1); null for pinned lanes and when a side added nothing.

fork.description: The commit on another lane the lane leaves from; null for the reference.

before.description: The lane continues before the frame (forked earlier): how many of its own commits are left of the frame. Drawn as an off-board connector at the left edge.

after.description: The lane continues after the frame (newer commits to the right).

refs.description: Branch and tag names pointing at the commit.

lanes.description: Lanes it is drawn on (two for a commit shared by twins).

grid.description: The drawing, one character per cell. Unlisted cells are empty.

cell.description: Lines leave the cell centre towards its connected sides. A lane passing under a vertical line is broken around it (`╴│╶`): a via, not a junction.

sides.description: Connected sides: 1 up, 2 right, 4 down, 8 left.

lane.description: The lane whose colour it takes.

node.description: A commit (`commit` gives which) or an off-board connector at a frame edge.
